concept: One remark, rebuilt in front of you. A warm, vague 'be a bit more engaged' hangs over Dev as a muted fuzzy cloud; the film zooms into the meeting-room whiteboard and the cloud becomes the first of three lines (observed behaviour, effect, next step). The same meeting room opens and closes the film: before, the cloud and a drained glow; after, Dev speaking with a clear bubble. Kind and specific end up in the same frame.

story.metaphor: A fuzzy cloud of a remark that sharpens into three lines on a whiteboard.
story.setting: One small office: a meeting room with a whiteboard, and a quiet coffee corner.
story.arc: Warm vague remark, nothing changes; the remark is rebuilt on the board into behaviour, effect, next step; a check; a calm two-way follow-up; the viewer's own rewrite; back in the meeting Dev shares a view first and they are on good terms.

cast.name: Manager
cast.role: the manager who gives the remark; screen left in every two-shot (faces right); also the presenter in b10. The script never names her, so the cast uses the role name.

cast.name: Dev
cast.role: the colleague who receives the remark; screen right in every two-shot (flip true, faces left). Never the neutral emotion (closed eyes): happy, surprised or explaining.

parts.what: Story-cartoon meeting room set, furniture only (no people): warm back wall, a window far left, a whiteboard with ink outline and a marker tray centred on the back wall at x 688 to 1232, y 120 to 426 (it is the board station's rect, so it must sit exactly there), a table across the bottom with its top edge at y 900, two chair backs behind where the busts sit, a small nameplate slot on the table edge at x 1440 for 'Dev'. Room light has three states.

The vague remark: a soft lumpy cloud in muted grey with a line-token outline and a faint inner blur, 'be a bit more engaged' inside in Patrick Hand ink. Never accent. Exposes the bounding box of the word 'engaged' so a brush circle can be drawn round it, and a shrink-to-line morph target (a horizontal bar) for b04.

The three-part board. 'board' variant: a whiteboard close-up, white surface with ink outline, three ruled slots stacked; slot 1 line 'one-word answers on vendors' with a duotone camera icon to its left, label 'observed behaviour'; slot 2 line 'we lost your view' with an empty-chair icon, label 'effect'; slot 3 line 'share a view first' with a small speech-bubble icon, label 'next step'. Lines in Patrick Hand; each label is an underline label set right of its line. The newest line is accent, earlier lines dim to muted. 'sheet' variant: the same three lines and icons, smaller, on a paper sheet lying on a table at a slight angle. 'empty' state shows the three ruled slots with no words.

Quiet coffee corner set, furniture only: a wall with a small round clock upper left, a closed door with a frosted pane on the right, a narrow counter whose top edge is at y 900 with two mugs on it, two stool tops behind the busts, a small hanging pennant hook above the counter. Warm, low-contrast light.

kit.notes: People are never kit parts: the Manager and Dev are peeps placed by the scenes with literal kit.peep calls. Hands in b06 are Loom.hands (placeholder set).

devices.what: The vague remark as a muted grey cloud over Dev; it hangs, gets 'engaged' circled, morphs into board line 1, and dissolves in the payoff.
One board changed by additions: a line per beat with its underline label after it; newest line accent, earlier lines dim. Empty as the presenter's card, a paper sheet on the table in b11 and b12.
A small duotone camera icon beside what a recording could show: board line 1, kept on the sheet in b11 and b12.
A warm accent3 halo round Dev meaning 'it felt nice to hear'; blooms on 'Dev glows', drains on 'Nothing changes', never returns.
A chat bubble that shows whose turn it is: the manager's question hands over to Dev's bubble in the coffee corner, and Dev's clear bubble carries the change in the payoff.
Join material: the cloud shrinks and morphs into board line 1 on the zoom into the whiteboard; the presenter card becomes the paper sheet on the counter.

value_script.accent: none; Dev's glow is accent3 and the cloud is muted
value_script.why: Pale, warm open: the pleasant moment the film will question.
The slip: the room drops a step so the empty Tuesday is the loudest thing.
Richer middle on the board; one line lit at a time while the others dim.

value_script.accent: none until the answer; then the quiz.answer takeaway
value_script.why: Calm even paper for the check so neither option is favoured.

value_script.accent: Dev's bubble as the turn passes to him
value_script.why: The rest valley: a quiet, warmer room, low contrast.
Open, clear frame for the viewer's own rewrite.
Back in the warm coffee corner.
Lift at the close: the opening room returns brighter than it began, colour withheld until Dev speaks.

scenes.subject: a manager gives Dev a warm vague remark; he glows and nothing changes

design.treatment: Story-cartoon two-shot in the meeting room. Manager bust left, Dev bust right across the table, whiteboard blank behind between them. The remark arrives as a muted fuzzy cloud over Dev; a warm accent3 glow blooms round him, then drains while the cloud just hangs.
design.why_motion: The point is a change over time: the glow arrives and leaves while the cloud stays, so the viewer sees the good feeling pass and nothing else move.
